name: content-container
description: Single-zone, width-constrained section intended for text-only editorial content (paragraphs, headings, lists, links). Wraps the zone in a Bootstrap container-xl so content matches the standard NT Government page width, with 16px horizontal padding applied on viewports narrower than the container-xl breakpoint (1200px). Editors should restrict this zone to text content; do not insert components, media, or layout blocks.

zones.description: Primary text content area. Intended for text-only editorial content (paragraphs, headings, lists, inline links). Do not insert components, media embeds, or nested layouts.
